hook: Most budgets fail within weeks, and it's usually the system, not you. In this video I look at budgeting from three angles: the numbers (where the average household's $77,000 goes, the 50/30/20 rule, and the subscription leak most people underestimate by more than half), the 5 reasons your brain fights your budget, and a 12-step four-account system you can set up in one weekend.
shorts: Your budget didn't fail because of you. It was the system.
